use: CMS Part C payment-year parameters for non-PACE MA organizations, copied from the final Rate Announcements. A program rulebook entry (config/agere/programs*) with a risk_adjustment block overrides these.

2025.source: Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2025 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies, April 1, 2024

pages.blend: p.80: 67% of the 2024 CMS-HCC model (V28) + 33% of the 2020 CMS-HCC model (V24)

2026.source: Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2026 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies, April 7, 2025

pages.blend: p.4 and p.62: 100% of the risk score from the 2024 CMS-HCC model (V28) for non-PACE organizations

formula: payment RAF = (sum over models of blend_m x round(raw_m / normalization_m, 3)) x (1 - MA coding pattern adjustment); raw scores from the community segment.
not_loaded: PY2027 tables and factors; PACE blends; ESRD and RxHCC models; frailty factors.
